name: Arham Technologies Ltd
tagline: Raipur-based consumer-appliance OEM and own-brand maker (Smart LED TVs, fans, coolers, washing machines) that grew revenue ~70% to ~Rs 119 Cr in FY26 and is migrating from NSE Emerge to the main board - but it is a low-value-add assembly business at ~33x earnings after a 103% run, with 177 debtor days
business_overview: Arham Technologies (incorporated 2013, NSE SME Emerge listed Dec 2022) manufactures Smart LED TVs, ceiling fans, air coolers, washing machines, mixer grinders and other consumer appliances, both as an OEM and under its own STARSHINE (premium) and ARATTON (mass-market) brands. Sovrenn Daily News seed (2026-09-02); Sovrenn trigger: board approval to migrate the listing from NSE Emerge (SME) to the NSE Main Board.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 445 Cr (NSE Emerge, migrating to main board); P/E ~33x; up ~103% in a year
PAT ~Rs 12.2 Cr (+67.8% YoY); EBITDA ~Rs 19.0 Cr (+50% YoY)
NSE Emerge -> Main Board migration approved - a liquidity / re-rating event, not a fundamental catalyst
fundamentals_narrative: Revenue up ~70% and PAT up ~68% in FY26 on stronger appliance demand and deeper distribution, with a clean promoter holding (~72%, no pledge) and a main-board move coming. But the business itself is low-value-add appliance assembly / OEM with own brands that are not established outside the region - a fiercely competitive segment with thin, volatile margins, component-import exposure to China, and no real moat. Working capital is heavy (177 debtor days, a channel-stuffing / collection risk), and at ~33x earnings after a 103% one-year run the growth is already in the price. The Sovrenn trigger is only a listing migration. No VP thread.
technical_read: Not pulled. Up ~103% over the year; NSE Emerge SME.
sentiment_summary: No ValuePickr thread. Web/filings/news-only: FY26 results (revenue Rs 118.6 Cr +70%, PAT Rs 12.2 Cr +68%, EBITDA Rs 19.0 Cr +50%), the main-board migration approval, and a promoter no-encumbrance confirmation.
bse_notes: No SEBI or fraud action found. Promoter holding ~72.4% with no encumbrance. Board approved migration from NSE Emerge to the NSE Main Board.
